description: The full DCSA-style event timeline of one shipment (gate in, load, departure, arrival, discharge, ...), oldest first. Use it when the user wants the history; get_shipment already includes the last few actual events. `shipment` (required) is the BerthTime id, the tracked reference, or a container number on the shipment. Optional: classifier (ACT actual, EST estimated, PLN planned; default all), limit (most recent N, 1-500, default 50). Returns: shipment_id, reference, events[] {at, timezone, precision, classifier, code, type, description, location, un_locode, vessel, voyage, container}. Times are UTC.

classifier.description: ACT actual, EST estimated, PLN planned. Default: all.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

limit.description: Most recent N events (returned oldest first).

shipment.description: BerthTime shipment id, or the tracked reference (container, bill of lading or booking number), or a container number on the shipment.

name: get_shipment_events
title: Shipment events
